name: Talvash del Kissel
summary: In Ironforge's Mystic Ward, the gnome jeweler Talvash del Kissel is down on his luck. He fled Gnomeregan when the troggs overran it, then fell into debt amid rumors of questionable dealings. Now he turns to adventurers to recover lost treasures and restore shattered relics. His eye for gems and ancient baubles makes him a valued contact for those exploring Uldaman.

sections.title: From Artisan to Exiled Debtor
sections.body:
Talvash once earned respect as a jeweler in Gnomeregan, until the troggs overran the city and destroyed his livelihood along with his home. He escaped with the surviving refugees to Ironforge and set up camp in the Mystic Ward. Yet relocation brought little relief.

Rumors of questionable dealings and unpaid obligations gathered around him, leaving the craftsman in deep financial distress. Unable to rebuild his trade through conventional means, he now relies on freelance adventurers to recover lost assets and salvage his reputation.

sections.title: Relics of Uldaman and Gnomish Craft
sections.body: Talvash has kept his precision with gems and his skill at judging their worth. When explorers in the Badlands uncover an ancient, shattered necklace deep in Uldaman's Titan vault, few craftsmen in the Eastern Kingdoms can make sense of its intricate enchantments. Restoring its power takes rare components and painstaking work. Talvash is eager to do it, both to clear his debts and prove his skill endures.

faq.answer: Talvash is a gnome jeweler exiled from Gnomeregan who now lives in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. Burdened by debt and rumors, he hires adventurers to repair artifacts and settle his accounts.
Talvash lives in Ironforge's Mystic Ward, near the pond and the magic-oriented shops.

faq.q: What happened to his business in Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Talvash ran a jewelry trade in Gnomeregan before the troggs invaded and the city fell. He lost everything, and rumors and poor fortunes left him deeply indebted in Ironforge.

faq.q: What is Talvash's connection to Uldaman?
faq.answer: Explorers who find a shattered power source in Uldaman's ancient dig site are directed to Talvash. His skill with gems and enchanting lets him reconstruct the shattered necklace for adventurers who gather its missing pieces.

faq.q: Does Talvash have anything to do with Gnomeregan quests?
faq.answer: Yes. Talvash helps recover personal items left behind during Gnomeregan's evacuation, including lost rings and devices.

angles.text: Talvash shows how Gnomeregan's fall shattered ordinary civilian lives, leaving master craftsmen as broke exiles scraping by in Ironforge.
Alliance adventurers exploring Uldaman or Gnomeregan's ruins can turn to Talvash to restore ancient jewelry and recover lost gnomish heirlooms.
